# YM50: 三潭印月 Santan Yinyue

Wave 2 · Yuanming Yuan · 3D: `/reconstruction/3d.html?b=YM50` · Page: `/scenes/#YM50` · Row: `research/buildings/YM50-santan-yinyue/`

## What it was

三潭印月 Santan Yinyue, north-west of 方壶胜境 on 福海's north-east, named after the West Lake view; further north-west across a bridge 天宇空明 with 澄景堂 behind, 清旷楼 east and 华照楼 west (S05 j82:13b-14a). The 方壶胜境 preface: 'to the east 蕊珠宫, to the west 三潭印月, clear and bright' (S05 j82:13a). S361 places it beside the 方壶胜境 temple garden (E1852). Burned October 1860 (S02 pp.187-188).

From the inventory row: **destroyed** 1860 (S05, S41, S01).
